checkMessages: Disposable Markdown opens.
Disposable ordinary document opens.
The formatting command associated with Ctrl+B routes to the active rich-text editor.
The live ToggleBold command changes the selected ordinary text.
The formatting command associated with Ctrl+I routes to the active rich-text editor.
The live ToggleItalic command changes the selected ordinary text.
The formatting command associated with Ctrl+U routes to the active rich-text editor.
The live ToggleUnderline command changes the selected ordinary text.
Dirty inactive Markdown is retained.
All seven localized settings navigation labels fit the default pane without horizontal clipping.
Theme System applies immediately without changing the document.
Theme Light applies immediately without changing the document.
Theme Dark applies immediately without changing the document.
Theme Sepia applies immediately without changing the document.
Startup and default-template selectors immediately save through production preference stores.
Changing startup screen does not navigate or close the current document.
Changing the actual language selector updates open help, retains topic and clears old-language search.
Language returns to the requested culture and saves immediately.
Workspace selection uses only the isolated demo folder.
About shows the real assembly release version.
Manual check displays busy status and disables concurrent checks.
No newer release hides the banner and reports current version.
Fictional update version parses.
A fictional newer release appears through production version comparison and notification.
Later dismisses the current notification.
Skip persists only the demonstrated version in the isolated update store.
Automatic check respects its interval after a manual check.
Manual check bypasses interval and skipped-version suppression.
Network failure reports a localized retry action and hides stale release information.
Canceled manual check has a distinct state without starting an installer.
Reopening settings restores the chosen startup/template/language from isolated preferences.
Routed F1 opens modeless help owned by the active main window.
Menu-equivalent reopening activates one existing help instance.
Search returns available articles from only the current language.
Enter in the real search field opens its selected result.
An unmatched query has a visible empty-results state.
Escape in search clears the query and returns contents.
Image command opens the actual local image overlay and focuses Close.
Escape closes enlargement and restores article position and focus.
History restores the article and reading position.
Forward returns to the next article.
Reopened help restores the last topic.
Settings and help preserve both dirty documents byte for byte.
Settings/help preserve the AI message object and unsent draft without invoking a model.
All persistent validation stores remain inside their disposable root.
In-memory settings Save was exercised.
No WPF binding errors.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Production settings, immediate language/theme changes, update service/coordinator/notification with fictional release metadata, routed F1/Enter/Escape and help navigation. Verify mode reads all nine embedded topics/images.
limitations: No live GitHub request, real download, UAC, installer launch/upgrade, installed-profile migration, physical keyboard/mouse or DPI acceptance. Synthetic HTTP/download/integrity/cancellation and profile migration are checked separately by existing tests.
